pvtFrance.h1: France Working Holiday Visa: understand the WHV and prepare your application without getting lost.
pvtFrance.heroDesc: The Working Holiday Program allows young people from eligible countries to live and work in France for up to one year. The challenge is not the visa itself — it is preparing the administrative application. Veasy helps you organize every step.
pvtFrance.whatIsTitle: What is the France Working Holiday Visa?
pvtFrance.whatIsPara1: The Working Holiday Program (WHV France) is a bilateral agreement between France and several countries including Brazil, Argentina, Canada, Australia, and Mexico. It allows eligible nationals to stay in France for up to 1 year with the right to work, without needing to prove a prior employment contract.
pvtFrance.whatIsPara2: The goal of the WHV France is to facilitate cultural exchanges between young adults (generally between 18 and 30 or 35 years old depending on the country). It is a unique visa that combines tourism, cultural immersion, and the possibility of working to fund your stay.
pvtFrance.whatIsPara3: The difficulty lies not in understanding the visa itself, but in preparing the application: several documents to gather, validity deadlines to respect, a consulate appointment to anticipate. That is exactly what Veasy organizes for you.
pvtFrance.etape1Desc: Confirm that your nationality and age meet the criteria of the Working Holiday Program with France.
pvtFrance.etape2Desc: Identify the documents required by the French consulate based on your profile. The list varies depending on your nationality.
pvtFrance.etape3Desc: Obtain, validate, and organize each document following compliance criteria (format, date, signature).
pvtFrance.etape4Desc: Reserve your slot at the French consulate via France-Visas. Slots open 2 to 3 months in advance.
pvtFrance.etape5Desc: Present your complete application on appointment day. Every document must be in the correct format and still valid.
pvtFrance.etape6Desc: Once the visa is obtained, organize your arrival in France: housing, transport, settling-in formalities.
pvtFrance.docsTitle: France Working Holiday Visa documents vary depending on your profile
pvtFrance.docsDesc: A France WHV application brings together several document categories: identity documents, financial proof, medical documents, insurance, and project evidence. But the exact list does not apply the same way for everyone.
pvtFrance.docsFactor1Desc: Each country has a specific agreement with France that defines its own requirements.
pvtFrance.docsFactor2Desc: Submission conditions and accepted documents vary from one consulate to another.
pvtFrance.docsFactor3Desc: Some documents expire after 3 months. Preparing too early means having to start over.
pvtFrance.docsCta1: No need to research what applies to you. Veasy automatically generates your checklist based on your profile, explains each document, and calculates exactly when to prepare it.
pvtFrance.errorsTitle: Mistakes that cause a France Working Holiday Visa application to fail
pvtFrance.errorsDesc: Most problems come not from lack of information, but from lack of organization.
pvtFrance.error1Desc: Bank statements and medical certificates expire after 3 months. If your appointment is in 4 months, you will have to redo everything.
pvtFrance.error2Title: Forgetting documents at the last minute
pvtFrance.error2Desc: Without a structured checklist, it is easy to miss a document — and discover it the day before the appointment.
pvtFrance.error3Title: Not knowing the right order to follow
pvtFrance.error3Desc: Some documents depend on others. Starting in the wrong order creates unnecessary bottlenecks.
pvtFrance.error4Desc: A document in the wrong format, missing a signature, or with an incorrect date can lead to immediate rejection.
pvtFrance.error5Desc: Without deadline tracking, you end up redoing certificates or statements that expired in the meantime.

pvtFrance.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about the France Working Holiday Visa
pvtFrance.faq1Q: What is the France Working Holiday Visa?
pvtFrance.faq1A: The Working Holiday Program (WHV France) is a bilateral agreement between France and several countries (Brazil, Argentina, Canada, Australia, Mexico...). It allows eligible nationals to stay in France for up to 1 year with the right to work, without needing to prove a prior employment contract.
pvtFrance.faq2Q: What documents are needed for the France Working Holiday Visa?
pvtFrance.faq2A: The application generally includes: application form, bank statement, medical certificate, criminal record, passport, identity photos, travel insurance, proof of address, visa fee receipt, motivation letter, plane ticket, CV and diplomas. The exact list varies by nationality — Veasy generates it automatically for you.
pvtFrance.faq3Q: How long does it take to prepare the application?
pvtFrance.faq3A: Between 4 and 8 weeks depending on your situation. Some documents (criminal record, insurance) can take time to obtain. Others expire quickly, like the bank statement (3 months). Veasy generates a personalized plan based on your departure date.
pvtFrance.faq4Q: When should you start the process?
pvtFrance.faq4A: At least 3 months before your planned departure. Some documents that take a long time to obtain (criminal record, approved doctor) need to be anticipated. Others on the contrary should not be prepared too early to avoid expiry.
pvtFrance.faq5Q: How to prevent a document from expiring before the appointment?
pvtFrance.faq5A: That is exactly the problem Veasy solves. The app automatically calculates the ideal window to prepare each document based on your consulate appointment date, taking into account their respective validity periods.
pvtFrance.faq6Q: Are the requirements the same for all countries?
pvtFrance.faq6A: No. The list of documents, required amounts, and some conditions vary based on your nationality and the relevant consulate. Veasy automatically adapts your checklist to your profile.
pvtFrance.faq7A: No, Veasy is not affiliated with any government. The app aggregates the official requirements published by the French consulate and updates them regularly. You always remain in control of your process.
pvtFrance.faq8Q: Can you use Veasy without creating an account?
pvtFrance.faq8A: Yes. Explorer Mode lets you see your full checklist and browse documents without email or password. You create an account only when you want to save your progress.
pvtFrance.faq9Q: What happens if a document expires before my appointment?
pvtFrance.faq9A: An expired document can lead to the immediate rejection of your application at the consulate. It is one of the most common mistakes: bank statements and medical certificates are only valid for 3 months. Veasy automatically calculates the ideal window to prepare each document based on your appointment date — you never present an expired document.
pvtFrance.faq10Q: Can you be rejected because of an incorrect document?
pvtFrance.faq10A: Yes. Wrong format, missing signature, non-compliant photo, or a document issued by a non-approved organization are enough for rejection. The consulate generally does not give a second chance on the spot. Veasy guides you through validating each document before submission.
